customIdsDemo.fixtureScope: genuine seeded core-init roster encoded with actual session codec; no turn, dice or cups were edited
customIdsDemo.helpText: Palifico. When enabled, a player starts palifico once, after their first loss from two dice to one and with at least three players remaining. There is none with two players left. Ones are not wild. The opening face stays locked by default. Both face-change exceptions require having started your own palifico before. Experienced one-die players also need exactly one die now; Any experienced player may have any remaining dice count. The current starter is never exempt.
